slices.title: Authoritative product contract and launch scope
slices.evidence: Approved direction and exclusions are recorded in docs/publishable-game-roadmap.md.

slices.title: Reproducible technical and evidence baseline
slices.evidence: Validation CLI, deterministic receipts, gameplay cohorts, and T480s qualification are documented in docs/roadmap.md.

slices.title: Faction-correct session and player perspective
slices.evidence: Perspective reaches input, fog, rendering, audio, HUD, AI, restart, and versioned saves; docs/roadmap.md marks this foundation delivered.

slices.title: Runtime scenario definition and world factory
slices.evidence: The strict production scenario parser, deterministic fresh-world factory, authored First Contact route, browser acceptance, and blind 1280x720 onboarding comparison passed.

slices.title: Mission registry and campaign profile
slices.evidence: The twelve-mission registry, versioned profile, production campaign lifecycle, archive accessibility, and six ship-ready quality dimensions passed. Conventional Arrow/Home/End listbox navigation remains optional polish.

slices.title: Camera controller interface
slices.evidence: The transactional camera lifecycle, capability-driven input isolation, resize/disposal behavior, and tactical/direct compatibility matrix passed. A consolidated throwing-controller Game integration test remains optional polish.

slices.title: Paired Spinal Nodes and alignment rules
slices.evidence: Explicit operational pairs, two-stage neutralization/recapture, reversible local Alignment, pair-only Dominance, deterministic AI, v1/v2 persistence, and visibility-safe HUD/minimap representation passed the bounded contract. Compact ALIGN wrapping remains optional polish.

slices.title: Directional advantage overlay and onboarding
slices.evidence: The bounded directional profile, conventional-flight gating, seam-safe overlay, non-color copy and ARIA, authoritative preview/fire agreement, real Siege Mode transition, First Contact completion path, and current regression lanes pass. G-01 remains the required real four-of-five novice gate; no human evidence is claimed.

slices.title: Shadow timing rules and overhead intelligence
slices.evidence: Atmosphere and shadow presentation foundations exist; launch gameplay rules and strategic intelligence remain unqualified.

slices.title: Dedicated whole-ring strategic side view
slices.evidence: Explicit launch scope with no completion receipt in the current roadmap.

slices.title: Gravity Range mode
slices.evidence: Explicit launch mode; current directional-artillery scenario is validation tooling, not a shipped mode.

slices.title: Layered district and bounded scatter foundation
slices.evidence: Existing battlefield dressing is presentation-only and does not establish the authored district system.

slices.title: Four reusable environmental district palettes
slices.evidence: Arc-City, Agricultural, Spinal/Industrial, and Breach/Evacuation palettes are specified but not delivered as reusable layers.

slices.title: Habitation, vegetation, transit, and ambient life
slices.evidence: Phase 3 presentation work is a visual foundation; launch-wide battlefield legibility remains an open gate.

slices.title: Integrated public-alpha tutorial arc
slices.evidence: First Contact passed one internal completion; broader novice completion and pacing evidence remain open.

slices.title: Air movement, targeting domains, collision, AI, and persistence
slices.evidence: No launch-scope air-domain completion evidence exists.

slices.title: Faction strikecraft and static air-defense roles
slices.evidence: Requested roles and faction variants are planned, not implemented.

slices.title: Generic cargo, embarkation, and destruction model
slices.evidence: Cargo is a declared dependency for transport and later chord insertion; no qualification evidence exists.

slices.title: Faction land and air transports
slices.evidence: Land and air transport roles with faction variants are launch scope and remain planned.

slices.title: Compact 01: First Contact release revision
slices.evidence: Existing alpha passed one internal completion; release onboarding cohort and revision remain open.

slices.title: Compact 02: Break the Line release revision
slices.evidence: Existing mission has automated and internal pacing evidence but is explicitly marked for revision.

slices.title: Compact 03: Counterfire release revision
slices.evidence: Existing mission passed internal play but is explicitly marked for release revision.

slices.title: Compact 04: A Signal in the Spine release revision
slices.evidence: Existing story slice passed internal play but is explicitly marked for release revision and transport integration.

slices.title: Compact 05: The Shadow Front
slices.evidence: New mission; no implementation or validation receipt exists.

slices.title: Compact 06: Anchor the Living
slices.evidence: New finale; no implementation or validation receipt exists.

slices.evidence: Planned mission; no implementation or validation receipt exists.

slices.title: Choir 05: What We Carry
slices.evidence: Planned mission; no implementation or validation receipt exists.

slices.title: Choir 06: Migration Window
slices.evidence: Planned finale; no implementation or validation receipt exists.

slices.title: Fixed-cannon Ballistic Arena
slices.evidence: Explicit launch mode; existing ballistic tools are not a shipped Arena mode.

slices.title: Skirmish productization and difficulty selection
slices.evidence: Faction-selectable skirmish and AI tiers exist, but the title still labels the flow as a development skirmish and release polish is open.

slices.title: Remappable input and scalable UI
slices.evidence: Current keyboard controls and compact HUD do not constitute qualified remapping and full UI scaling.

slices.title: Complete captions and accessibility qualification
slices.evidence: Cinematic captions and HUD accessibility foundations exist; release-wide qualification remains open.

slices.title: Versioned saves, offline startup, packaging, recovery, and rollback
slices.evidence: Versioned save migration exists; release packaging, offline startup, recovery, and rollback evidence do not.

slices.title: Browser demo, beta cohort, and tagged PC release
slices.evidence: Final release slice depends on all launch gates and reproducible artifacts.

gates.title: Directional artillery comprehension
gates.target: Four of five uncoached novices identify and exploit the favorable direction after onboarding.
gates.evidence: One successful internal observation is recorded; the broader five-player cohort remains open.

gates.title: Tutorial completion
gates.target: Four of five novices complete the tutorial arc without external coaching.
gates.evidence: One internal First Contact completion is recorded; the required novice cohort remains open.

gates.title: Faction strategic readability
gates.target: Blind testers describe the factions' strategic difference after one mission per side.
gates.evidence: Faction mechanics and presentation exist, but no blind one-mission-per-side cohort is recorded.

gates.title: Mission phase and approach quality
gates.target: Every standard mission has visible phase changes and at least two tested approaches where intended.
gates.evidence: Four Compact prototypes have internal evidence; the twelve-mission campaign and approach matrix do not exist.

gates.title: Inhabited battlefield legibility
gates.target: Every battlefield view contains a legible district function, landmark, vegetation, or habitation.
gates.evidence: Phase 3 battlefield presentation passed internal review, but launch-wide district coverage is not implemented.

gates.title: Air and cargo qualification
gates.target: Tests cover altitude, domains, interception, embarkation, destruction, landing, AI, and save/load.
gates.evidence: The air and cargo launch slices have not started.

gates.title: T480s 720p Low performance contract
gates.target: The accepted T480s 720p Low performance contract remains intact.
gates.evidence: docs/t480s-low-performance.md and docs/roadmap.md record the candidate hard gate as passed.

gates.title: Reproducible release artifacts
gates.target: Tagged artifacts pass save migration, offline startup, recovery, and rollback checks.
gates.evidence: Technical receipts are reproducible, but no tagged release artifact qualification is recorded.
